def main():
    totalItems = int(input())
    capacity = int(input())
    data = [int(input()) for _ in range(totalItems)]
    evenCounter = 0
    oddCounter = 0
    import heapq
    diffQueue = []
    for i in range(totalItems):
        if data[i] % 2 == 0:
            evenCounter += 1
        else:
            oddCounter += 1
        if evenCounter == oddCounter and i < totalItems - 1:
            heapq.heappush(diffQueue, abs(data[i + 1] - data[i]))
    totalCost = 0
    pairs = 0
    while diffQueue and totalCost + diffQueue[0] <= capacity:
        totalCost += heapq.heappop(diffQueue)
        pairs += 1
    print(pairs)

main()
